title: Encoding length bounded by width
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols, and let $d,c$ be natural numbers. For every natural number $n$, the configuration-code length at radius $2d(n+1)^c$ is at most the width $A(n+1)^{c+1}$, where $A$ is the coefficient specified by the machine and $d$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
